scope: V2 bootstrap only; excluded from the production migration runner and LP-0 inventory

required_catalog_assertions.job_binding: visible app.job; tenant and job qualified foreign keys
required_catalog_assertions.runtime: SELECT and INSERT; setting-column UPDATE only; no DELETE, TRUNCATE or ownership
required_catalog_assertions.routine: app.v2_chase_invoice_metadata(uuid); fixed search_path; PUBLIC revoked; bound read only

fresh_and_upgrade: Apply after 2001, repeat 2019 with retained settings/logs, assert catalog and retained counts
rollback_test: Force failure on command receipt insert after setting/log insert; no row or audit event survives
second_firm_test: Different linked practice firm cannot read, insert, update or delete first-firm state
audit_test: One command event and one per captured message; replay adds nothing; no message, amount or hidden finding in payload

chasing.failure: The decline fixture used a command unavailable in the V2 database.
